name: wp-soli-passport-plugin
description: OIDC client adapter that syncs roles and assignments from the Soli identity provider

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.i18n:make-pot: wp-env run cli -- bash -c 'php -d memory_limit=512M /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-passport-plugin wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-passport-plugin/languages/soli-passport.pot --domain=soli-passport --exclude=node_modules,e2e,tests,test-results'
scripts.i18n:make-mo: wp-env run cli -- bash -c 'php -d memory_limit=512M /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-mo wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-passport-plugin/languages wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-passport-plugin/languages'
scripts.i18n:make-json: wp-env run cli -- bash -c 'php -d memory_limit=512M /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-json wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-passport-plugin/languages wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-passport-plugin/languages --no-purge'
scripts.i18n:build: npm run i18n:make-pot && npm run i18n:make-mo && npm run i18n:make-json

author: Joran Out
